description: PTCP 2022 - Rischio Idraulico is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis.provincia.mantova.it. Il PTCP individua i Dissesti del territorio provinciale riconoscendo le aree a rischio idrogeologico molto elevato, le aree a rischio idraulico e le aree a rischio sismico.Le aree a rischio idrogeologico molto elevato sono individuate sulla base della valutazione dei fenomeni di dissesto idraulico e idrogeologico, della relativa pericolosità e del danno atteso. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Idrografia, territorio, Suolo, Zone a rischio naturale, rischio, open data. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
